_: TECHNOLOGY — each line with the one thing it scales with.
The College's platform is its own: the learning environment, the
assessment and recording workspace, the registry and public
verification, admissions and payments. It runs on Cloudflare (Workers,
D1, R2), takes payments through Stripe and sends email through Resend.
The people who build and run it are on the establishment (people.json);
this file carries only what the College buys.
Card processing is not technology. It is a cost of collecting revenue

fixedUsdPerMonth.s: Workers Paid plan, $5 a month minimum; includes the D1 database allowances. Cloudflare, Workers pricing — developers.cloudflare.com/workers/platform/pricing, retrieved 23 Sep 2026

requestsPerActiveLearnerMonth.s: About 130 page and application requests on each day of a month of study — lessons, submissions, recordings, results and messages

includedRequestsPerMonth.s: 10 million requests a month included. Cloudflare, Workers pricing — developers.cloudflare.com/workers/platform/pricing, retrieved 23 Sep 2026

usdPerMillionRequests.s: $0.30 per additional million requests. Cloudflare, Workers pricing — developers.cloudflare.com/workers/platform/pricing, retrieved 23 Sep 2026

cpuMsPerRequest.s: Average compute time of one request, generous for an application that mostly reads and writes records

includedCpuMsPerMonth.s: 30 million CPU milliseconds a month included. Cloudflare, Workers pricing — developers.cloudflare.com/workers/platform/pricing, retrieved 23 Sep 2026

usdPerMillionCpuMs.s: $0.02 per additional million CPU milliseconds. Cloudflare, Workers pricing — developers.cloudflare.com/workers/platform/pricing, retrieved 23 Sep 2026

rowsWrittenPerActiveLearnerMonth.s: Attendance, submissions, marks, second marks, feedback and messages written for one learner in a month

includedRowsWrittenPerMonth.s: D1: first 50 million rows written a month included (25 billion rows read are also included, far beyond the College's use). Cloudflare, Workers pricing — developers.cloudflare.com/workers/platform/pricing, retrieved 23 Sep 2026

usdPerMillionRowsWritten.s: D1: $1.00 per additional million rows written. Cloudflare, Workers pricing — developers.cloudflare.com/workers/platform/pricing, retrieved 23 Sep 2026

mbPerLearner.s: The permanent academic record of one learner: enrolment, marks, feedback and award — kept for as long as the College exists

includedGb.s: D1: first 5 GB of storage included. Cloudflare, Workers pricing — developers.cloudflare.com/workers/platform/pricing, retrieved 23 Sep 2026

usdPerGbMonth.s: D1: $0.75 per additional GB-month. Cloudflare, Workers pricing — developers.cloudflare.com/workers/platform/pricing, retrieved 23 Sep 2026

gbPerLearnerLevel.s: Recorded spoken papers, speaking practice and ten submitted assignments a level

usdPerGbMonth.s: R2 Standard storage, $0.015 per GB-month; egress is free, and request charges ($4.50 and $0.36 per million) are negligible at the College's volume. Cloudflare, R2 pricing — developers.cloudflare.com/r2/pricing, retrieved 23 Sep 2026

retentionMonths.s: Assessment evidence is retained for six years after it is made, the College's own retention period for assessment records

includedGb.s: R2: 10 GB-month of storage free each month. Cloudflare, R2 pricing — developers.cloudflare.com/r2/pricing, retrieved 23 Sep 2026

usdPerMonthAt.s: Resend transactional plans by monthly volume: free to 3,000; Pro $20 for 50,000 and $35 for 100,000; Scale $160 for 200,000, $350 for 500,000, $650 for 1,000,000. Resend, pricing — resend.com/pricing, retrieved 23 Sep 2026
usdPerMonthAt.u: USD per month at emails per month

emailsPerActiveLearnerMonth.s: Enrolment, schedule, results, moderation and conferral notices

usdPerHostMonth.s: Zoom Workplace Pro, $14.16 per user a month billed annually; education pricing ($10) is not assumed, because the College's eligibility is unconfirmed. Zoom, pricing — zoom.us/pricing, retrieved 23 Sep 2026

usdPerUserMonth.s: A planning allowance for a business email, calendar and document suite for every member of staff; no vendor price page could be read to confirm it, and the College's first purchase replaces it

gbpPerYear.s: One independent web application penetration test a year by a CREST-accredited UK provider, at the top of the published range (£3,750 to £6,250 and more; about £1,200 a day for three to five days). Precursor Security, Penetration testing cost — precursorsecurity.com/services/offensive-security/penetration-testing/cost, updated August 2026

usdPerHolderYear.s: Storage and serving of the permanent record for every award-holder, for as long as the College exists — the one cost whose driver never decays
usdPerHolderYear.u: USD per cumulative award-holder per year
